translation_notes: SD = Namespace(DEFAULT_ONTOLOGY) binds an IRI unknown until runtime, so it stays a plain Python Namespace object: no @prefix can be declared for it. Each g.objects(c79, SD.xFoo) becomes m{ {c79} {SD.xFoo} ?o } -- the predicate interpolated with bare {expr} in term position rather than a prefixed name, which is the correct outcome when the namespace's IRI is not a compile-time literal, not a workaround.

context shim: examples/.../asterism/__init__.py extends this package's __path__ to the real asterism.starrydata checked out under corpus/repos/kumagallium__asterism@f0977d4d3a, so original.py's `from asterism.starrydata import ...` resolves to the genuine ingester (ingest_curves) unmodified rather than a reinvented stand-in.
original.py restores the test file's own `_load(path)` helper (verbatim) so the region is executable standalone.
driver.py reproduces the `curves_csv` pytest fixture body verbatim and shares one tmp_path/curves_csv pair between both sides so run_pair's argument comparison sees identical values.

optimization_notes: optimized.py: the five reads into x_min … point_count and their five assertions become one loop over a table (local name of the aggregate, conversion, expected value — `pytest.approx(...)` for the two y values, `int` for pointCount), which reads `list(g.objects(c79, SD[name]))` and asserts its length and value; the two values the datatype assertions need are kept in a dict. The assertions run in the same order and are bare `assert`s, so the first failing one raises the same AssertionError as before; reading each aggregate just before its assertion instead of all five first changes nothing, since a read has no effect.

optimized.ldpy, from optimized.py: the read stays Python (rule 4). SD is a Namespace known only at run time, so the island would be `m{ {c79} {SD[name]} ?o }(g)`, two tokens longer than `g.objects(c79, SD[name])`; with a single read in the loop, the five islands of translated.ldpy collapse into one in Python as well, and nothing is left for the notation to fold. Only `XSD.double` / `XSD.integer` become the prefixed names `xsd:double` / `xsd:integer`. No exception to the symmetry rule.
The `@prefix xsd:` line of translated.ldpy's header costs more than the two prefixed names save, hence notation slightly above 1 on optimized.ldpy.
header_optimization_notes: optimized_header.py: BNode, Literal, DCTERMS, PROV, RDF, ingest_samples, parse_float_array and parse_sample_info go; the rdflib.namespace import keeps XSD only and the asterism.starrydata import fits on one line. The context lines (SD, _load) stay.
optimized_header.ldpy: the same, except that the rdflib.namespace import goes entirely (the region writes xsd:double / xsd:integer) and `@prefix xsd:` stays.
